name: folder
description: A solid horizontal folder with a straight negative-space panel divider.
authorship: Original filled geometry constructed for Squircle Icons; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner-requested rounder unboxed folder with the left/right primary edge pair at exactly 2 native units. Both style exteriors span x=2..22 and y=3.31979695..20.68020305, centered at 12,12. Visible aspect ratio is retained from the established Outline family (20 by 17.36040609); the shorter vertical axis is not stretched to force 2px top/bottom margins. Outline uses circular tangent fillets and unchanged Regular 1.70 stroke. Filled exterior is the exact 0.85 outward offset of the same lines and arcs, increasing convex radii and reducing concave radii while keeping arc centers fixed. No enclosing box is added. Folder body corner radii increase to 2.8/3.0 at the top and 3.25 at the base. The tab stays recognizable and its front-panel divider remains straight at y=10.9. The Filled divider gap remains strokeWidth-controlled, independent of the fixed exterior. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0. Owner-approved source. Global weight update requested by owner on2026-10-27: default Regular1.75 (half-width .875), Thin1.25 and Bold2.50, adjustable in .25 increments. Filled is rebuilt from these same Outline centerlines using rounded normal expansion, with solid-head/boxed/object semantics preserved. Menu/Search Filled follows Bold2.50. Centerlines uniformly refitted about12,12 by 0.9972677596 to retain the existing2px primary margins and shared boxed glyph clearance. Earlier1.70/2.25 construction measurements are historical; the current default reference is1.75.

review.note: Owner approved both Outline and Filled after rounder body corners, exact 2px left/right primary margins, retained horizontal proportions and matching unboxed outer contours. Reviewed at native proportions and Regular 1.70.
